## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Sudhāpiṇḍiyattheraapadāna* is a verse narrative preserved in the *Therāpadāna* section of the Pali Khuddakanikāya [SuttaCentral]. It relates the karmic background and past meritorious actions of the elder (thera) Sudhāpiṇḍiya. SuttaCentral lists five modern translations across five languages for this text [SuttaCentral].
While DharmaNexus finds no cross-language matches meeting its threshold, SuttaCentral notes cross-references or connections to *Dhammapada* verses 195 and 196, as well as Chinese Āgama and verse parallels in the *Faju jing* (T 210.22), the *Chu yao jing* (T 212.22, T 212.31), and the *Faji yaosong jing* (T 213.21, T 213.30) [SuttaCentral]. Within the Pali tradition, DharmaNexus identifies 37 matching passages shared with 13 other texts [DharmaNexus]. Its opening verses (§1.1–2.4) correspond closely to passages in the *Dhammapada-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Aṅguttaranikāye Ekakanipāta-ṭīkā*, the *Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā*, and the *Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaabhinavaṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. Later verse units (§6–9) exhibit extensive formulaic reuse with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* and other poems in the *Therāpadāna*, such as the *Bhikkhadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 103), *Suvaṇṇabibbohaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 273), and *Subhūtittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 23) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
